# Bundled QR libraries

- ZXing Core 3.5.3 — Apache-2.0. Original artifact: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/google/zxing/core/3.5.3/core-3.5.3.jar. License: `zxing/LICENSE`. Used locally by the Android camera scanner; no network service.
- QRCoder 1.6.0 (.NET Framework 4.0 build) — MIT, copyright Raffael Herrmann. Original package: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/qrcoder/1.6.0/qrcoder.1.6.0.nupkg. License: `qrcode/LICENSE.txt`. Embedded into the Windows executable.

The versions are pinned. The build does not download dependencies.
